Welcome to the City of Example

The City of Example serves more than forty thousand residents across six wards. This site is the place to find city services, apply for permits, pay a water bill, read council agendas and minutes, and see what is happening in your neighborhood. Every department lists its office hours, its phone number, and the forms it accepts online, so you can get most things done without a trip to City Hall.

Council and public meetings

The Common Council meets on the first and third Tuesday of each month at seven in the evening in the council chamber on the second floor of City Hall. Agendas are posted at least three days ahead, and video of every meeting is kept online. You can read local laws in the city code, and you can sign up to speak during the public comment period at the start of each meeting.

Report a problem

Potholes, broken streetlights, missed trash pickups and graffiti can all be reported online at any time of day. Each report gets a tracking number, and you can follow its progress until a crew closes it out. For emergencies, always call nine one one first.
